(Minor data drift) Problem statement claims settings were reset to coins_per_like=1/coins_per_comment=2/cap=10, but DB still has 3/4/3 from iter6. Admin should reset via Admin Panel → Settings → Economie if those defaults matter for launch.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py:296-317 find_video_by_id_or_slug — does FOUR sequential find_one calls (id, slug, legacy_slug, slug-prefix-regex). For unknown keys this is 4 round-trips. Consider a single $or query with all 3 exact-match keys; keep the regex fallback as the 2nd query only when the first returns nothing.

/app/backend/server.py:786-792 POST /videos/{id}/view — no rate-limiting per-IP/user/session, so view counter is easily inflatable by automation (test confirmed +3 from 3 calls). If accurate view counts matter for ranking/analytics, add a debounce window keyed by (ip+vid) or (user+vid) similar to the like-coin idempotency pattern.

/app/backend/server.py:2105-2147 shop_leaderboard — when viewer.coins is 0 (or null) `above` counts every user with positive coins, so the rank could be misleadingly large. Consider tie-breaking by `created_at` or `username` to make rank stable across reloads (currently top-N order is also unstable when coins are tied).

/app/backend/server.py:1010-1021 list_comments — $in over [video_id, legacy_id] is correct; ensure backfill stamped `legacy_id` (not just `legacy_slug`) on migrated video docs, otherwise migrated comments stay invisible. Spot-check: VID 1fa97503... has 51 comments now (16 historic + tests); count via slug == count via UUID confirmed equal.

/app/backend/server.py build_video_slug — slugify on Romanian/diacritic titles strips diacritics but produces very long ASCII slugs (the 67-char test case produced ~75-char slug). That's fine for browsers, but if you ever index `videos.slug` in Mongo, watch the 1024-byte key limit.

rca_of_the_issue: All 5 reported bugs were fixed correctly in this release: (1)+(2)+(3) — the new helper find_video_by_id_or_slug + resolve_video_id is wired into every /videos/{id}/* endpoint, and the comment INSERT uses the resolved canonical UUID (server.py:1059-1068). list_comments additionally $in's over [video_id, legacy_id] to surface migrated docs. (4) build_video_slug no longer truncates — title 'Sora iubitei mele cu tate mari m-a sedus si mi-am dat drumul in ea' produced 'sora-iubitei-mele-cu-tate-mari-m-a-sedus-si-mi-am-dat-drumul-in-ea-1854e5' (verified). (5) SSR endpoint /api/og/video/{key} returns proper og:title+absolute og:image; localhost:8001/watch/{key} crawler middleware also returns og:title HTML — both UUID and slug forms verified. Plus new feature (6) /api/shop/leaderboard correctly returns {top:[10], me:{rank,...}}; me is included even when viewer is in top N (server.py:2128-2147).
